payout_quote: New donors can earn up to $750* in the first 35 days with new donor promotions. *May vary by location and change without notice.
steps: Find an Octapharma Plasma center on the official site.

Attend your first visit with a valid photo ID, proof of Social Security number, and proof of current address (dated within 60 days): registration, health screening, and a physical exam (about two hours total).
Complete your first plasma donation; Octapharma states you are eligible for special new-donor payments during your first 35 days.
Continue donating (up to twice a week) during the 35-day window to accrue toward the new-donor total; compensation is loaded to a prepaid debit card within 24 hours of each donation.
catches: $750 is an 'up to' ceiling that 'may vary by location and change without notice' — per Octapharma's own disclosure.
You must be 18-70, weigh at least 110 lbs, be in good health, and pass the health screening and physical exam; not everyone qualifies.
Each donation visit takes roughly 90-150 minutes of your time; you must donate repeatedly (twice weekly for new-donor offers) to earn the headline totals.
Reaching the first-35-day total requires donating repeatedly (up to twice a week) for 35 days, not a single visit.
The first visit takes about two hours (registration, screening, exam, donation); return visits are quicker.
biggest_catch: The $750 is an 'up to' ceiling that varies by location and can change without notice — and you must pass the medical screening and physical exam; not everyone qualifies.
eligibility: 18-70 years old, at least 110 lbs, in good health; valid photo ID, proof of Social Security number, and proof of current address (dated within 60 days); must pass health screening and physical exam. Compensation varies by location.
timing: Compensation is loaded onto a prepaid debit card within 24 hours after each successful donation; the new-donor total accrues across donations in the first 35 days.
